subject: reasoning
question:
Identify the figure from among the given options which when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6724af5817f96095b040b68429f7ccb291cc3ee8d78054f54038a773d85320c4.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Top-right corner letter shifts in bottom-left corner and flipped horizontally.

And remaining letter is replaced by a new letter.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a837275e33857922f8938aa66c53a1b02fd92134624ac9f65c91b3da62399e66.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4".**
